title: Lie algebra is tangent space at identity
statement: For a field k and group scheme G over Spec k, after the canonical identity residue-field identification, the Lie algebra Lie G is k-linearly equivalent to the dual-number tangent space of G at the identity.

source.place: The infinitesimal-point identification in the identity tangent-space paragraph

proof.text: Use the explicitly specified upstream equivalence identityTangentTransport from infinitesimal points to scheme tangent vectors and its formula identityTangentTransport_val. Obtain its multiplication and scalar compatibility from identity_tangent_transport_operations. Compose this equivalence with lieEquiv.symm.

Build a LinearEquiv from this type equivalence. Its additivity follows by rewriting lieEquiv_symm_add and then the transport multiplication identity. Its scalar compatibility follows by restricting Lie scalars through Scheme.ΓSpecIso.inv, rewriting lieEquiv_symm_smul and then the transport scalar identity.

The adopted upstream construction lieIdentityTangentEquiv implements the same linear equivalence with exactly this restricted scalar structure. Its defining formula is lieIdentityTangentEquiv_apply. Use this construction directly in the parent instead of the duplicate Sheaf Nonempty wrapper; the mathematical dependencies are unchanged.
